braintreeNonce.description: Payment method nonce generated by Braintree SDK after tokenizing the card details. This single-use token is created when card information is submitted through Braintree Hosted Fields and optionally verified with 3D Secure. Required when paying with Braintree.

braintreeDeviceData.description: Device fingerprint data collected by Braintree Data Collector for fraud protection (Kount). This JSON string should be obtained during checkout via BraintreeDataCollector.create() and getDeviceData().
